index.x-help: The case index in the file plan, e.g. 03-01 (unit, then case number).

retention.x-help: As in the list of standard documents: 75 years, 5 years, permanently.

retention_ref.x-help: The article of the list of standard documents the period comes from.

permanent.x-help: Kept permanently (handed to the state archive).

retention_years.x-help: How many years the case is kept, counted from the 1st of January after its year. Decides the inventory and when it may be disposed of.

document_types.x-help: Signed documents of these types and this year are filed into the case. A type goes into one case a year.

organization_id.x-help: The unit that keeps the case.
